 New York Red Bulls vs Inter Miami LIVE streaming, TV channel, kick-off time & where to watch MLS 2026
 By Sushruta Follow Add as Preferred Source From football pitches to bookshelves, always chasing a good story. Published at : October 25, 2026 at 2:00 AM (GMT+5:30) Modified at : October 25, 2026 at 2:00 AM (GMT+5:30) Both sides remain in playoff contention in the Eastern Conference.
 Inter Miami will travel to Sports Illustrated Stadium to take on New York Red Bulls in a Round 31 fixture in Major League Soccer (MLS) 2026 on Saturday night. Both sides are in the top nine in the Eastern Conference, remaining in playoff contention.
 A superb brace from Lionel Messi powered Inter Miami to a 3-1 away win at Atlanta United in their last outing. This marked the third consecutive win for the Herons, who had earlier beaten DC United 4-0 and New York City FC 2-0.
 Inter Miami are currently in second place in the Eastern Conference table with 55 points, building a 100% domestic record following the international break. Kily Gonzalez’s side have understandably relied on Messi’s magic, with the Argentine veteran registering a goal contribution in his last 14 games.
 New York Red Bulls , meanwhile, are just above the playoff line, sitting in ninth place with 36 points. The home side come into this fixture following back-to-back defeats. A narrow 2-1 loss to DC United was followed by a 2-0 defeat at home to Toronto FC.
 In fact, Michael Bradley’s side have lost three of their last four MLS matches. They have also failed to score in two of them, scoring the joint-fewest goals (39) among MLS sides in playoff positions.

 The match will take place on Saturday, October 24, 2026, at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, New Jersey. In India, the match will kick off at 3:00 AM IST on October 25.

 Where and how to live stream New York Red Bulls vs Inter Miami in India?
 Fans in India can watch the match live online on the Apple TV app and website with the required subscription.
 Where and how to watch New York Red Bulls vs Inter Miami live in the UK?
 Fans in the UK can watch this MLS 2026 fixture live on the Apple TV platform.
 Where and how to watch New York Red Bulls vs Inter Miami live in the USA?
 Apple TV will show the match live online in the United States.
